rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (already correctly identified by main agent): expo-crypto was pulled in as a transitive dependency of unused expo-auth-session at a version that referenced expo.modules.kotlin.types.AnyTypeCache — a class that does not exist in expo-modules-core 3.0.30 (Expo SDK 54). The version drift was caused by tilde-versioning (~) on the expo-* packages combined with no resolutions block, so yarn was free to upgrade expo-crypto to a patch built against a newer expo-modules-core. FIX: Removed unused expo-auth-session entirely, pinned every expo-* package to exact versions, added explicit expo-modules-core 3.0.30 dependency, and added a yarn resolutions block forcing expo-modules-core 3.0.30 + expo-crypto 15.0.9 across the whole tree. Also enhanced the Windows nuclear-rebuild script to purge stale gradle AAR caches that could still contain the mismatched compiled classes. STATIC VERIFICATION CONFIRMS THE FIX IS IN PLACE; on-device validation pending on user's Windows machine.
